operator_notes: St Colmcille's Holywood — dated notice pages, PDF hidden in a PDF Embedder Premium iframe (class pdfembed-iframe, src=?pdfemb-data=<base64 json {url:...}>), not a public a.pdfemb-viewer href.
Stable slug: /bulletins/bulletin-notice-sunday-{Dth}-{month}-{YYYY}/. Confirmed live 20/08/2026: 16th August 2026 exists; 23rd August 2026 is HTTP 404. Do not invent next Sunday.

Iframe target for 16 Aug 2026: https://www.stcolmcillesholywood.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Bulletin-Notice-16th-August-2026.pdf (HTTP 200, application/pdf, 380331 bytes, 3 pages, body text '16th August' + Holywood).

Listing /weekly-bulletins/ also lists the same posts, but can look stale in search snippets. site_type:waf_retry_wordpress scrapes that listing first, then predicts rewrite_date_url Sundays and skips 404s.
Origin is SiteGround-style 403-flaky (curl often 403; plain urllib retries get 200). Skip Playwright.
do_not: Do not hardcode /bulletin-notice-sunday-23rd-august-2026/ — that slug 404s until the parish posts it.
Do not treat the listing as a direct PDF page — the PDF is only inside the notice-page iframe.
Do not switch this to a Playwright click recipe — the origin 403s browsers more often than plain HTTP.
